How Murphi.ai Works

Connect via APIs or Login to Experience AI Automation

Murphi.ai is an AI-native platform built for three distinct audiences — each with their own integration path, their own model, and their own set of benefits.

PaaS — For Healthcare Platforms

Add AI features to your platform via encrypted APIs

Integrate Murphi.ai into your EHR or healthcare platform via encrypted API, SSO, or iFrame. Your customers get AI-powered workflows immediately — under your brand, with zero token cost to you.

  • Encrypted API · SSO · iFrame · FHIR R4 · HL7 v2
  • White-labeled — your brand, your customers
  • Zero token cost — Murphi absorbs AI infrastructure
  • Data and IP remain yours entirely
Explore PaaS →
SaaS — For Providers & Agencies

Log in and deploy AI modules for your workflows

Log into Murphi.ai and access AI modules purpose-built for your workflows — clinical documentation, revenue assurance, patient payments, and contract optimization.

  • 4 core live modules — more coming soon
  • Integrates with your existing EHR
  • Per-module reports, analytics, and audit logs
  • HIPAA-grade security across every module
See core modules →
Channel — For Compliance, QAPI & Billing Consultants

Serve your clients better with AI

Compliance consultants, QAPI firms, and coding/billing companies use Murphi.ai to deliver AI-powered services to their agency clients — their way.

  • Managed Services — run AI reports for your clients
  • Self-Service — give clients their own workspace
  • White-label the entire platform under your brand
  • 90–95% AI accuracy + human review workflow

Home Health, Hospice & Palliative Care

Home Health Agencies Hospice Organizations Palliative Care Teams SNFs

Post-acute care runs on documentation complexity, reimbursement rules, and OASIS compliance. Murphi.ai automates the highest-burden workflows so clinicians spend time on patients, not paperwork.

Ambient AI / Scribe
Record visits, auto-generate OASIS notes, SN visit notes, and upload to EHR. 70% time saved.
Revenue Assurance
AI-driven coding review, OASIS accuracy validation, and compliance documentation for HH/hospice billing.
Private Pay
Text-based collection of co-pays and patient-responsible amounts. AR cycle drops from 100 to 15 days.
Care Coordination
PHI-secure messaging, document sharing, and EHR-synced care team communication.

Health Systems & Hospitals

Health Systems Hospitals Ambulatory Networks IDNs

Health systems carry complex payer contracts, high patient-responsible balances, and growing documentation burdens. Murphi.ai automates all three — optimizing contracts, collecting patient payments, and reducing clinician charting time.

AI Contract Analyzer
PADU Plus methodology — surfaces payer underpayments, flags non-compliant clauses, and optimizes reimbursement rates across your payer mix.
AI Patient Financials
Automate co-pay, deductible, and coinsurance collections via text-to-pay. Provider paid within 48 hours via Everyware gateway.
Ambient AI
Voice-to-note clinical documentation for inpatient and outpatient clinicians. Reduces charting time by 70% — synced directly to your EHR.
RCM Automation
Pre-authorization, coding accuracy, claims submission, denial management, and remittance reconciliation — coming soon.

Primary & Specialty Care

Primary Care Practices CHCs / FQHCs Specialty Clinics DME

Primary and specialty practices lose hours to charting and struggle to collect patient-responsible balances. Murphi.ai eliminates both — AI documentation from voice and automated text-to-pay collections, without adding headcount.

Ambient AI
Generate SOAP notes and specialty-specific templates (cardiology, sleep, pain, allergy, vascular) from voice. 55 languages. Syncs to your EHR automatically.
AI Patient Financials
Text-to-pay for co-pays, deductibles, and balances. Patients pay via SMS link — no app download required. AR cycle drops to 15 days.
Billing & Claims — E&M
Eligibility verification, charge readiness, ICD/CPT coding, claims submission, and denial management. Coming soon.
Engage — HIPAA Messaging
HIPAA-compliant patient messaging — reduce call volume and hold times. Coming soon.

Mental & Behavioral Health

Outpatient Behavioral SUD Programs Residential Treatment IOP / PHP

Behavioral health documentation is high-volume, compliance-sensitive, and structured. Murphi.ai generates clinical notes from voice, automates self-pay collections, and keeps every session audit-ready — without adding administrative burden.

Ambient AI
Generate PIE, BIRP, SOAP, and DAP notes from voice. Assessment forms (GAD-7, PHQ-9, AUDIT-C) auto-populated. Every note audit-ready at session end.
AI Patient Financials
Self-pay and out-of-pocket collections via text-to-pay. Bad debt reduced by 75%. No patient app download required.
Case Management
Automate treatment plans, goal summaries, utilization reports, and care plan documentation directly from clinical conversations.
Engage — HIPAA Messaging
HIPAA-compliant care team and patient messaging. PHI-secure. Coming soon.
